method.prompt: Photorealistic, the same night, moments later, a barefoot girl of about nine with reddish-gold hair under a patched gray coat, clutching a bundle of matchboxes shivering hard in the same narrow alley corner between two dark brick houses at night, snow piled against the walls, a single dim street lamp glowing, wrapping the coat tighter, teeth chattering, deciding on a second match.
